# How loops form within the unfolding

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`how-loops-form` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](how-loops-form.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A loop forms by closing: the loops formed by T + 1 are those formed by T and those through a coupling acting at T that closes a chain; with every condition listed, growth before it forms is polynomial and does not show it will; with strengths read off the course, formation is read off the unfolding.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. The strengths before step T keep the couplings acting before T and drop the rest; its couplings are exactly those acting at some step before T, and they rise with T. The loops formed by T are its loops; every chain of couplings is formed by some step, so a world's loops are exactly the loops formed by some step, and likewise what lies upstream. (`Becoming.Closing.ble_false_of_lt`, `Becoming.strengthsBefore`, `Becoming.strengthsBefore_before`, `Becoming.strengthsBefore_from`, `Becoming.strengthsBefore_le`, `Becoming.couplesAt_before_iff`, `Becoming.couples_before_iff`, `Becoming.couples_before_mono`, `Becoming.couples_of_before`, `Becoming.couples_before_of_couplesAt`, `Becoming.Coupled.lift`, `Becoming.OnLoop.lift`, `Becoming.Upstream.lift`, `Becoming.coupled_formed`, `Becoming.onLoop_iff_formed`, `Becoming.upstream_iff_formed`)
2. A loop forms by closing: the loops formed by T + 1 are the loops formed by T and those through a coupling acting at step T that closes a chain, reading a level of d and giving to c, with chains from c through the loop's condition to d. So a loop that forms passes through a coupling acting at the step it forms; an exchange coming to respond to the level of the condition it gives to forms a loop of one. Chains join, and a coupling with chains into and out of a condition closes a loop through it. (`Becoming.Closing.join`, `Becoming.Closing.join_below`, `Becoming.Closing.join_from`, `Becoming.Coupled.append`, `Becoming.Coupled.one`, `Becoming.onLoop_of_closing`, `Becoming.Upstream.refl`, `Becoming.Closing.split`, `Becoming.onLoop_succ_iff`, `Becoming.forms_by_closing`, `Becoming.responds_to_own_level`)
3. The carried amount up to step T reads only the couplings acting before T. So with every condition listed and no loop formed by T upstream, the carried amount at every step up to T is at most a polynomial in the steps, of degree one less than the number of conditions, whatever the couplings do later. (`Becoming.carriedGive_congr_strength`, `Becoming.carried_before`, `Becoming.inflow_before_le`, `Becoming.carried_le_polynomial_before`)
4. The amounts before a loop forms do not show whether it will: a self-loop of strength one forming at step T carries the starting gap unchanged up to T and doubles it at every step after; it forms at T and not before; and a loop forming at any later step carries the same amounts up to T. (`Becoming.Closing.Onset.strengths`, `Becoming.Closing.Onset.amount`, `Becoming.Closing.Onset.strengths_early`, `Becoming.Closing.Onset.strengths_late`, `Becoming.Closing.Onset.amount_succ_early`, `Becoming.Closing.Onset.amount_succ_late`, `Becoming.Closing.Onset.amount_before`, `Becoming.Closing.Onset.amount_after`, `Becoming.Closing.Onset.forms`, `Becoming.Closing.Onset.not_formed`, `Becoming.Closing.Onset.unforeseen`)
5. Where a law's strengths at each step are read from the levels up to that step only, the law giving what its read strengths make of the levels reads what has stood, and the course it generates is the carried amount of the strengths it reads: which loops form, and when, is read off the unfolding. (`Becoming.ReadsBefore`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.carryingRead`, `Becoming.formedCourse`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.carryingRead_nonanticipating`, `Becoming.formedCourse_succ`, `Becoming.formedCourse_eq_carried`)
6. The threshold witness: the part gives one unit at each step, and the exchange of the formation outside it with the condition responds to its level once that level has reached θ. The level is t up to θ; the loop forms at step θ and not before; from then the level plus one doubles at every step; and up to θ the course is the same for every threshold beyond it. (`Becoming.Closing.Threshold.reading`, `Becoming.Closing.Threshold.reads`, `Becoming.Closing.Threshold.level`, `Becoming.Closing.Threshold.strengths`, `Becoming.Closing.Threshold.strengths_eq`, `Becoming.Closing.Threshold.level_succ`, `Becoming.Closing.Threshold.level_before`, `Becoming.Closing.Threshold.level_le_succ`, `Becoming.Closing.Threshold.level_ge`, `Becoming.Closing.Threshold.level_after`, `Becoming.Closing.Threshold.not_formed`, `Becoming.Closing.Threshold.forms`, `Becoming.Closing.Threshold.unforeseen`)
7. In a world: a world whose strengths are read off its own standing balances, stands at the carried amount of the strengths it reads, up to T stands as the balanced world its couplings formed before T carry, and grows at most polynomially before a loop of them forms; in the threshold world the loop of couplings read off its standing forms at θ, not before; the self-loop from T on is a balanced world doubling from T. (`Becoming.formedWorld`, `Becoming.formedWorld_balanced`, `Becoming.formedWorld_level`, `Becoming.formedWorld_le_polynomial_before`, `Becoming.formedCouplings`, `Becoming.formedWorld_before`, `Becoming.FormedLoops.onsetWorld`, `Becoming.FormedLoops.onsetWorld_level`, `Becoming.FormedLoops.onsetWorld_course`, `Becoming.FormedLoops.thresholdWorld`, `Becoming.FormedLoops.thresholdWorld_level`, `Becoming.FormedLoops.readOff`, `Becoming.FormedLoops.thresholdWorld_course`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. What each theorem needs is written into it: the strengths k as supplied bounds, or strengths κ read from the levels up to each step (ReadsBefore); in the polynomial bound, every condition listed, the part giving no gap after the start, starting gaps at most D and the strengths into each condition at most M a step.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That the closing coupling did not act before T: selecting such a coupling would need a decision of whether a coupling acted before T, and the core assumes no excluded middle; the theorem says it acts at step T.
- Which strengths a world reads off its course; when loops of read strengths form, for every law.
- A runaway after formation for every law: what doubles is the most difference that can arrive (the self-loop and threshold witnesses), not every law's actual gap.
- **Counterexample:** A self-loop forming at step T and one forming later carry the same amounts up to T, after which one doubles: no bound on what follows comes from the amounts before formation. <a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

On 16 October 2026 Ren took P118's third reading in its refined form, “which loops a world has is part of its situation; loops form and dissolve within the unfolding, and the theorems take them as they stand at each step”, and said “leave it pending until a loop-formation theorem exists”; the same day Ren asked for “a theorem showing how loops form within the unfolding … let's finish both”. This result is that theorem. Readings (the AI's, agreed by Ren on 16 October 2026): loops form within the unfolding by closing, at the step some exchange comes to respond to a level downstream of the condition it gives to; with strengths read off the course the loops are part of what the unfolding forms; a loop's formation is not foreseen from the amounts before it, which meets Becoming.Runaway: what carries it is what the couplings themselves couple into. How loops dissolve is P120's (couplings that stop).

  - Output: Couplings, chains, loops, upstream; the polynomial bound with no loop; the self-loop.

- related, not a proved adapter: [orders-as-a-sum-over-histories](orders-as-a-sum-over-histories.md). The other item of the same day: P118's orders as P82's sum over histories; loops are where both multiply, and here is the moment they form.
- related, not a proved adapter: [loops-within-what-a-law-reads](loops-within-what-a-law-reads.md). Within one law: loops lie within what is read and form where reading grows; for a law reading a stock only below a threshold there is no loop through the stock before the break, and the loop forms at the break.
